# You can install the .wgt file to your Samsung TV from Windows 10 or Linux or Android or Iphone.

# I demonstrated the steps to install .wgt in details for both Windows 10 pc and Android phones.

Note [Apps2Samsung](https://github.com/Apps2Samsung/Apps2Samsung/releases) asks you to sign the .wgt with your Samsung account ; so you need to have a Samsung account ( create one if you don't have ) and it will redirect to your browser when it needs you to confirm.

*Installing the .wgt file from Windows 10 pc*

1- open "Command Prompt" ( cmd ) on your windows pc + type "ipconfig" and press "enter". Look for: "Ethernet adapter Ethernet:" and you will see: "   IPv4 Address. . . . . . . . . . . : 192.168.1.6". Keep that local ip address in mind ( this is this the ip address of the pc ).

2- Open "Wifi Status" on your Samsung TV to check your network information and see the TV's local ip address, it will be something like: "192.168.1.7".

3- Open Samsung App Store on the TV by clicking "Apps", then tap on these numbers in row: "12345", enable "Developer mode", and insert the local ip address of the pc ( you can naviage beteen the fields with Right/Left remote buttons ), tap on "ok", close "Samsung App Store", hold the power button of the remote for 3-5 seconds untill it shows "Samsung Logo" ( this step is called "cold restart", it just clears /tmp files of the TV ).

4- Download [Apps2Samsung](https://github.com/Apps2Samsung/Apps2Samsung/releases) on your pc ( choose Apps2Samsung-v3.3.0-win-x64.zip ) or any newer version, extract it, Open it, it will recognize the TV automatically ( if not, write the local ip address of the TV manually, if not recognized, make a "cold restart" again on the TV and re-open Apps2Samsung again and it will recognize it, if not write the local ip address of the TV manually ), choose: "Install a file..." and choose the downloade .wgt file, wait a 5-12 seconds, it Done installing.

5- Go to "Apps" on the TV and add the installed app to your home screen by tapping UP button on the remote while focusing on its icon.

6- Open "Samsung App Store", then tap on these numbers in row: "12345", keep Developer Mode: ON, change the local ip address to: "127.0.0.1", tap on "ok", make a "cold restart".

7- Enjoy :)

==================================================================

*Installing the .wgt file from an Android phone*

1- Install [Fing](https://www.rockmods.net/apps/fing-mod-apk) app on your Android phone, you can know the local ip address of both the TV and the phone itself.

2- Open "Wifi Status" on your Samsung TV to check your network information and see the TV's local ip address, it will be something like: "192.168.1.7".

3- Open Samsung App Store on the TV by clicking "Apps", then tap on these numbers in row: "12345", enable "Developer mode", and insert the local ip address of the pc ( you can naviage beteen the fields with Right/Left remote buttons ), tap on "ok", close "Samsung App Store", hold the power button of the remote for 3-5 seconds untill it shows "Samsung Logo" ( this step is called "cold restart", it just clears /tmp files of the TV ).

4- Download [Apps2Samsung](https://github.com/Apps2Samsung/Apps2Samsung/releases) on your Android phone ( choose "Apps2Samsung-v3.3.1-android.apk" ) or any newer version, Open it, it will recognize the TV automatically ( if not, write the local ip address of the TV manually, if not recognized, make a "cold restart" again on the TV and re-open Apps2Samsung again and it will recognize it, if not write the local ip address of the TV manually ), choose: "Install a file..." and choose the downloade .wgt file, wait a 5-12 seconds, it Done installing.

5- Go to "Apps" on the TV and add the installed app to your home screen by tapping UP button on the remote while focusing on its icon.

6- Open "Samsung App Store", then tap on these numbers in row: "12345", keep Developer Mode: ON, change the local ip address to: "127.0.0.1", tap on "ok", make a "cold restart".

7- Enjoy :)
